leave it to me phrase

also I’ll see to it, I’ll take care of it, I’ll deal with it, I’ll handle it, let me worry about that

classical

Ter. Ad. 538: Fuge modo intrō; ego vīderō.
Cic. Att. 12.21.1: sed ipse vīderit (Lewis & Short)

Ego vīderō.

I’ll see to it

(vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Ter.; Cic. in epistulīs)

The future perfect of videō puts a matter off, onto oneself or onto another: ipse vīderit, “let him see to that himself” (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • Ego istuc cūrābō. — I’ll take care of that

    also used · classical · Plaut. Amph. 949: Ego istuc cūrābō.

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

Examples

  • Fuge modo intrō; ego vīderō.

    Just get inside; leave it to me.Ter. Ad. 538

  • Ego istuc cūrābō.

    I’ll take care of that.Plaut. Amph. 949

See also ensure, don’t worry!, care.
